title: Derived Cech comparison for the sheafified Godement ring model
statement: Let $(C,J,O)$ be a small ringed site with the derived category of $O$-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let $m$ make the concrete Godement family [def-weil-pbc-ring-complex-godement-construction] strictly functorial [def-weil-pbc-ring-complex-cech-data]. For any finite global section list $f$, the extended Čech complex [def-weil-pbc-ringed-extended-cech] is isomorphic in the derived category to the explicit sheafified Godement-family model [def-weil-pbc-functorial-ring-complex-sheaf]. The isomorphism commutes with their maps to $O[0]$. This concerns one global list and contains no ideal-sheaf gluing or finite-type ideal hypothesis.

source.place: Tags 099D(c),(d), lemma-all-rings, and 099E, lemma-global-extended-cech-complex, final paragraph

proof.text: The Godement ring model has its augmented ordered localization Cech model. Resolve it over a section ring by a K-flat complex. The normalized semilinear maps to every restriction ring extend to scalar-extension chain maps preserving the augmentation. The augmented Cech base-change theorem makes these maps quasi-isomorphisms.

Sheafify degreewise, preserving quasi-isomorphisms by exact module sheafification. Fraction base change identifies the localization terms and maps with the finite ordered tensor of the one-element localization complexes; the alternating signs are the tensor differential signs. Both maps preserve the augmented ring term. Invert the quasi-isomorphisms in the derived category.

theorem ringFamilySheafModel_cech
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O))]
    (m : RingComplexMaps (fun A I ↦ ringComplexGodement A I.val))
    (hm : RingComplexFunctorial (fun A I ↦ ringComplexGodement A I.val)
      (fun A I ↦ ringComplexGodementAugmentation A I.val) m)
    (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → (O.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections) :
    ∃ e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (ringedExtendedCech O r f).1 ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (ringFamilySheafModel O (fun A I ↦ ringComplexGodement A I.val)
            (fun A I ↦ ringComplexGodementAugmentation A I.val) m hm r f).1,
      e.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map
          (ringFamilySheafModel O (fun A I ↦ ringComplexGodement A I.val)
            (fun A I ↦ ringComplexGodementAugmentation A I.val) m hm r f).2 =
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (ringedExtendedCech O r f).2
